scope: Direct form/newsletter/legal selectors; preserve desktop and mobile rules
rules: .footer__newsletter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--s-4); }
.footer__newsletter-desc { display: block; color: var(--c-label-on-dark); line-height: var(--lh-row); }
.footer__legal { flex-direction: row; gap: var(--s-5); padding-top: 0; margin-top: 0; }
